items.Sentence: The Fillmore WRP discharges disinfected tertiary recycled water to the soil and groundwater via percolation ponds, a trench disposal system, subsurface percolation zones, surface spray irrigation systems, and subsurface drip irrigation systems within the City of Fillmore.

The Fillmore WRP discharges disinfected tertiary recycled water to the soil and groundwater via percolation ponds, a trench disposal system, subsurface percolation zones, surface spray irrigation systems, and subsurface drip irrigation systems within the City of Fillmore.

Discharge from the Fillmore WRP was previously regulated under the following requirements: ... Order No. R4-2006-0049 ... regulated effluent discharged to percolation ponds and effluent as recycled water for Title 22 non-potable applications.
